name: FlowCheckout for WooCommerce
author: SwiftlyWP

sections.description:
FlowCheckout for WooCommerce replaces the default WooCommerce checkout page with a modern, conversion-optimized checkout experience inspired by Shopify.

Built for store owners who want a professional checkout without hiring a developer — FlowCheckout transforms your entire checkout flow in minutes.

Why FlowCheckout?

The default WooCommerce checkout is outdated and costs you sales. FlowCheckout gives your store:

  • A modern, clean design that builds trust and reduces friction
  • Mobile-first layout that works perfectly on all devices
  • Faster checkout flow with smart field management and inline validation
  • Full compatibility with all major payment gateways and shipping plugins

How It Works

  1. Install & Activate — Enable FlowCheckout from the plugin settings
  2. Choose Your Layout — Select the Shopify-style two-column layout
  3. Customize the Design — Pick colors, fonts, and field styles to match your brand
  4. Go Live — Your new checkout is ready for customers

Key Features (Free Version)

Checkout Layout

  • Shopify-Style Two-Column Layout — Main content on the left, order summary on the right — the layout customers trust most
  • Responsive Design — Fully optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop
  • Collapsible Order Summary — Mobile-friendly summary that expands on tap
  • Full-Page Checkout — Optional distraction-free mode that removes your theme header and footer

Design Customization

  • 6 Design Presets — Default, Minimal, Dark, Warm, Bold, and Shopify-inspired themes
  • 10 Color Controls — Primary, button, background, sidebar, border, error, success, text, and muted text colors
  • Form Field Styles — Outlined, underline, or filled input styles with adjustable border radius and height
  • Button Customization — Filled, outlined, or rounded buttons with full-width or auto-width options
  • Label Positions — Above field, floating label, or placeholder-only modes

Field Management

  • Customizable Section Headings — Rename Contact, Delivery, Payment, and Billing sections
  • Field Labels & Placeholders — Customize every checkout field label and placeholder text
  • Phone Field Control — Show/hide phone, set required or optional
  • Company Field — Enable company name with optional/required toggle
  • Address Line 2 — Show/hide with expandable toggle option
  • Order Notes — Enable with expandable toggle and custom placeholder
  • Billing Address — Same-as-shipping toggle to reduce form length

Order Summary

  • Product Images — Show product thumbnails in the summary
  • Quantity Badges — Visual quantity indicators on product images
  • Itemized Totals — Subtotal, shipping, taxes, and discount rows
  • Custom Heading — Rename the order summary section

Checkout Features

  • Coupon Field — Show in summary sidebar or below checkout fields, with expandable option
  • Shipping Method Display — Radio buttons or dropdown, with options to hide when only one method or hide paid methods when free shipping is available
  • Delivery Method Toggle — Ship or pick up toggle when local pickup is available
  • Legal Compliance — Terms & conditions checkbox and privacy notice with customizable text
  • Sign-in Link — Show returning customer login prompt

Checkout Header & Footer

  • Custom Logo — Upload your logo via the WordPress media library
  • Logo Link Options — Link to homepage, shop, cart, custom URL, or no link
  • Security Badge — Optional lock icon with “Secure Checkout” text
  • Return to Cart Link — Customizable back-to-cart text
  • Footer Links — Add custom footer links (refund policy, shipping info, etc.)
  • Custom Footer Text — Add copyright or trust text below checkout

Payment Gateway Compatibility

FlowCheckout works with all major WooCommerce payment gateways:

  • Stripe
  • PayPal
  • Square
  • Authorize.Net
  • Mollie
  • Cash on Delivery
  • Bank Transfer (BACS)
  • And all other standard WooCommerce gateways

Developer Friendly

  • All standard WooCommerce checkout hooks preserved
  • Third-party plugins that add checkout fields continue to work
  • Theme-overridable templates
  • CSS custom properties for advanced styling
  • No jQuery conflicts — vanilla JS checkout

Pro Features

Upgrade to FlowCheckout Pro for advanced features:

  • Multi-Step Checkout Layout — Guide customers through 3 clear steps: Contact, Shipping, Payment
  • Single-Column Layout — Centered narrow layout for a focused checkout experience
  • Express Checkout — Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal express buttons
  • Trust Badges — Display security and payment trust badges
  • Order Bump — Add last-minute product offers before payment
  • Sidebar Widgets — Payment icons, guarantee badge, support info, testimonials, free shipping bar
  • Address Autocomplete — Google Places or Mapbox address suggestions
  • Typography Controls — Google Fonts, font sizes, and label font weight
  • Cart Editing — Allow customers to update quantities directly in checkout
  • Marketing Consent — Opt-in checkbox with GDPR-ready tracking
  • Custom Fields — Add custom checkout fields
  • Custom CSS — Add your own CSS directly from the settings panel
  • Custom Thank You Page — Personalized order confirmation
  • Integrations — Mailchimp, Klaviyo, and Google Analytics 4
  • Priority Support — Direct support from the development team
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/flowcheckout-for-woocommerce/ or install through the WordPress plugin screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to FlowCheckout → Settings to configure your checkout
  4. Enable FlowCheckout on the General tab
  5. Customize the layout, design, and fields to match your brand

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.faq:
Will FlowCheckout work with my theme?

Yes. FlowCheckout replaces the checkout page template and includes its own styling, so it works with any properly coded WordPress theme. It has been tested with Storefront, Astra, GeneratePress, Flatsome, OceanWP, Divi, Hello Elementor, and Avada.

Does it work with my payment gateway?

FlowCheckout preserves all standard WooCommerce checkout hooks, so any payment gateway that works with WooCommerce will work with FlowCheckout. This includes Stripe, PayPal, Square, Authorize.Net, Mollie, and all other standard gateways.

Will it break other plugins that add checkout fields?

No. FlowCheckout fires all the same WooCommerce checkout actions and filters that the default checkout uses. Plugins that add fields via woocommerce_checkout_fields or inject content via checkout hooks will continue to work.

Can I customize the colors and fonts?

Yes. FlowCheckout includes 10 color controls, 3 form field styles, 3 button styles, and 6 design presets. The Pro version adds Google Fonts, font size controls, and label font weight options.

Does it support coupon codes?

Yes. The coupon field can be placed in the order summary sidebar or below the checkout fields, with an optional expandable toggle.

Is it mobile responsive?

Absolutely. FlowCheckout is built mobile-first with a responsive design that adapts to phones, tablets, and desktops. The order summary collapses on mobile for a streamlined experience.

Can customers edit their cart on the checkout page?

Yes. When enabled, customers can update product quantities directly in the checkout order summary without going back to the cart page.

Does it support local pickup?

Yes. When local pickup is configured as a shipping method in WooCommerce, FlowCheckout shows a delivery method toggle (Ship / Pick up) that automatically adjusts the form fields.

  • Custom footer with links and text
  • Full payment gateway compatibility
